title: Expand realistic PC assembly learning guides
summary: PC Lab component details now explain connections, fitting order and placement reasons for realistic hardware learning.

Added practical assembly guidance for motherboard, CPU, cooler, RAM, SSD, GPU, PSU, fans, battery, Wi-Fi and other parts, with a cautious generic fallback.
Kept AI Teacher handoff available beside the expanded hardware explanation.
